paper_metadata.title: DreamLLM: Synergistic Multimodal Comprehension and Creation
paper_metadata.abstract: This paper presents DreamLLM, a learning framework that first achieves versatile Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) empowered with frequently overlooked synergy between multimodal comprehension and creation. DreamLLM operates on two fundamental principles. The first focuses on the generative modeling of both language and image posteriors by direct sampling in the raw multimodal space. This approach circumvents the limitations and information loss inherent to external feature extractors like CLIP, and a more thorough multimodal understanding is obtained. Second, DreamLLM fosters the generation of raw, interleaved documents, modeling both text and image contents, along with unstructured layouts. This allows DreamLLM to learn all conditional, marginal, and joint multimodal distributions effectively. As a result, DreamLLM is the first MLLM capable of generating free-form interleaved content. Comprehensive experiments highlight DreamLLM's superior performance as a zero-shot multimodal generalist, reaping from the enhanced learning synergy. Project page: https://dreamllm.github.io.

extraction_data.innovation: Dream queries (learnable embeddings): encapsulates semantics encoded by MLLMs to condition a pretrained Stable Diffusion image decoder without altering the MLLM's output space, avoiding modality-specific conflicts from explicit CLIP-MLLM alignment; Interleaved Generative Pre-Training (I-GPT): uses a unique `<dream>` token to predict image placement within text, leveraging causal generation to model joint, marginal, and conditional distributions of images and texts, enabling synergistic comprehension and creation.
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised fine-tuning, Supervised fine-tuning on instruction-following data
extraction_data.extension: Dream queries (64 learned tokens) act as cross-attention keys/values to bridge MLLM embeddings and diffusion U-Net latents, enabling structured attention maps that capture subject and background semantics independently of text tokens.
extraction_data.application: Zero-shot multimodal generalist, interleaved document generation, visual-language comprehension, content creation
extraction_data.paper_title: DreamLLM: Synergistic Multimodal Comprehension and Creation
extraction_data.training_corpus_size: 30M pairs (Stage I), 4M pairs (Stage II), 120K samples (Stage III)
extraction_data.finetuning_data: LLaVAInstruct, InstructMMC4, LAION-COCO, Instruction-following data curated with GPT-4
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Cross-attention between dream queries and U-Net latent features
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pretraining on interleaved multimodal data with joint learning objective; ablation studies compare creation-only, comprehension-only, and joint-learning approaches.
extraction_data.fusion_architecture: Unified autoregressive generation in raw multimodal space
extraction_data.benchmark_result: MM-Vet: 35.9; VQAv2: 56.6; COCO FID: 8.46; MS-COCO FID: 8.46; MMBench: 49.1
